checks: A booking does not wait for email
It leaves a row in the queue
Nothing is sent until the queue is drained
The dispatcher refuses a call with no secret
And one with the wrong secret
A refused call claims nothing
A patient cannot claim the queue
Someone signed out cannot claim the queue
Nor read it
Draining marks it sent
A Scheduler gets the alert by email
It comes from the configured sender
A patient hears by email
With the specific time in Manila
The session date
The therapist, location and reference
And an HTML part
A confirmation has a calendar link
The link returns a calendar file
It holds the session in UTC
With the location and reference
And names nobody
The therapist hears too
A reschedule email has a calendar link
The file keeps the same entry
And a higher sequence and the new time, so calendars replace it
A cancellation has no link to add it
The reason arrives, and can't inject HTML
The calendar file now says it is cancelled
An unknown token finds nothing
A malformed token is refused
Nobody can search calendars through the API
Only known languages are accepted
A person can set their language
A Filipino reader gets a Filipino email
All of it
The therapist still gets their own language
A real backlog is waiting
Runs can overlap
No row is claimed twice
Overlapping runs send each email once, not twice
A failure retries four times, then stops
Each try is counted
And waits longer each time
The reason is kept
A failed row is left alone
A row left claimed by a dead run is picked up again
One being sent right now is left alone
The job is scheduled
The scheduled job drains the queue by itself
environment: real local Auth, PostgREST, Edge Functions and Mailpit with disposable synthetic accounts
